country.evidence_quote: Destiny USA is New York State's largest shopping, dining and entertainment destination of its kind. Its 2.4 million square feet bring together retail and outlet brands, restaurants, family attractions, entertainment and an on-site hotel. The 2026 Destiny USA marketing package describes the property as the ninth-largest shopping center in the United States and the number-one tourist destination in Central New York.
